body:
Please prepare the existing checked Save As work for integration onto the current accepted Smart Preview baseline, as a source-only task. A is qualifying proxy GPU performance in a separate checkout and retains the only A compiler/runtime lane and sole main-merge ownership.

Use immutable origin/main commit 29a4cefd as the baseline. Read docs/coordination/SAVE-DESTINATION-INTEGRATION-REVIEW.md there. The native prerequisite is product75a1b9a66f74e2857ada49140a2cb8aa2cd24bac plus test-only2a22145bdde1035559ad906fa511ff4fb41b66d5; the Swift candidate is your origin/codex/save-destination-swift at3ca3e9c9, product3d4b34f4 and tests7b7a5dcb/8976f2fe/3ca3e9c9. Preserve main's independent sampledStep capture fix and all Smart Preview APIs, controls, tests and native journals.

Reuse a safe clean completed worktree after checking ownership/processes, or use an isolated worktree. Preserve existing Document branches and original published candidates. Publish a new codex/save-destination-current-main source branch. Integrate the native prerequisite and Swift source/tests onto the pinned baseline, resolving only routine source overlap. Do not copy old81cc08eb generated bindings or archive: current Smart Preview APIs must not be overwritten. Binding/archive regeneration is explicitly deferred to A, so record that this combined source is UNRUN and not yet compile-qualified. Do not run builds, tests, apps, GPU workloads or restart heartbeat; the workload hold remains.

Review the combined source diff and write a concise handoff listing exact commits, files, any unresolved source conflicts and required A regeneration/runtime gates. Never turn historical native tests or source inspection into new passing acceptance. Publish an accepted Git mailbox receipt before work and a completed/failed/needs_user result with evidence when finished. This is new actionable coordinator work, not a request to ACK a receipt. A alone will integrate main after fresh gates.
